Purpose of this disclaimer

This disclaimer applies to https://rjmlaird.co.uk, including its pages, articles, resources, downloads, tools, media, links and other material made available through the site.

It should be read alongside the terms of use, privacy notice and cookie notice.

In this disclaimer, “I”, “me” and “my” mean Ryan J. M. Laird. “You” means anyone using, viewing, sharing, relying on or otherwise interacting with this website and its content.

General information only

The content on this website is provided for general information, education, discussion and professional context. It may include commentary, analysis, personal perspectives, practical guidance, examples, opinion, case-study material, links, resources and exploratory work.

Content is not intended to be comprehensive, definitive, complete or suitable for every purpose. It may not reflect the latest developments, evidence, legislation, regulation, standards, policy, technical practice or sector conditions.

You should assess whether information is relevant and appropriate for your own circumstances before acting on it. Where a decision could have legal, financial, technical, regulatory, health, safety, educational or other significant consequences, obtain appropriate independent professional advice.

No professional advice

Nothing on this website constitutes, or is intended to constitute, legal, financial, tax, investment, insurance, accounting, medical, mental-health, therapeutic, employment, recruitment, regulatory, compliance, engineering, safety, academic or other specialist professional advice.

You must not rely on website content as an alternative to advice from a suitably qualified professional who understands your specific circumstances, obligations, risks and objectives.

Any discussion of strategy, communication, marketing, digital systems, websites, analytics, sustainability, space, science, public engagement, education, career development or related topics is presented for general context. It does not create a professional-client relationship, duty of care, fiduciary relationship, guarantee or obligation to provide services.

If you require professional services, the scope, deliverables, fees, responsibilities, intellectual-property rights, confidentiality, cancellation arrangements and liability provisions must be agreed in writing before work begins.

Science, space and sustainability

Content relating to science, space, astronomy, Earth observation, climate, sustainability, technology, artificial intelligence, environmental data, policy and innovation may simplify complex subjects for communication or educational purposes.

Scientific understanding, technical standards, regulatory requirements, operational conditions, commercial information, mission status, data availability and policy positions can change. Statements may be incomplete, time-sensitive, illustrative or dependent on context.

You should verify important claims against current primary sources, official guidance, peer-reviewed research, applicable standards and appropriately qualified advisers before using them in operational, commercial, legal, policy, safety-critical, academic or public-facing decisions.

References to space missions, agencies, programmes, companies, products, datasets, research, policies or public figures do not imply endorsement, partnership, sponsorship or approval unless explicitly stated.

Educational content

Educational resources, explanations, exercises, examples, diagrams, calculations, study suggestions and related material are provided to support learning and curiosity. They are not a substitute for formal teaching, assessment, pastoral support, safeguarding arrangements, examination guidance or professional educational advice.

Learners, parents, guardians, teachers and schools remain responsible for checking suitability, accuracy, curriculum alignment, supervision, accessibility and safe use in their own setting.

Examination specifications, qualification requirements, marking criteria and educational guidance can change. Always check the current information supplied by the relevant awarding organisation, school, college, university or regulator.

Nothing on this website guarantees grades, examination outcomes, university admission, employment, progression, funding or any other particular result.

AI-assisted content

Some content, code, templates, research workflows, images, summaries or other materials may have been created, refined, translated, analysed or supported using artificial-intelligence tools. Where used, these tools are intended to support, not replace, human judgement, editorial review and subject-matter understanding.

AI-generated or AI-assisted material can contain errors, omissions, outdated information, unsupported claims, bias, fabricated references, insecure code or unsuitable recommendations. You are responsible for independently reviewing, testing and validating any material before using it.

In particular, do not rely on AI-assisted content from this site without appropriate professional review where it may affect safety, law, compliance, finances, health, children, security, privacy, critical infrastructure or significant personal or organisational decisions.

Do not submit confidential, personal, commercially sensitive, controlled, export-restricted or otherwise protected information into third-party AI tools unless you have authority to do so and have assessed the relevant terms, security, privacy and legal implications.

Accuracy and currency

I aim to present information carefully and in good faith. However, I make no representation or warranty that website content is accurate, complete, current, reliable, suitable for a particular purpose or free from errors or omissions.

Content may be updated, corrected, expanded, withdrawn, archived or replaced at any time without notice. Older material may remain available for context even where elements have become outdated.

If you believe that content is materially inaccurate, misleading, out of date, infringing or otherwise problematic, please contact me using the details below and include the relevant page URL and a clear explanation.

Availability and security

Information on this website about services, areas of expertise, formats, availability, prices, approaches, projects or examples of work is informational only. It does not constitute a binding offer, quotation, commitment to provide services or guarantee of availability.

Any advisory work, communication support, digital work, speaking contribution, media activity, editorial commission, tutoring, mentoring, workshop, event participation or collaboration is subject to separate written confirmation.
